title: Semantic Matching
description: Discover relevant connections between your notes using AI-powered semantic matching

steps.title: What is Semantic Matching?
steps.description: Notention analyzes your notes' content and properties to find semantically similar or complementary notes across the network.

steps.title: Open Matches View
steps.description: Click the matches icon in the sidebar or press Ctrl+Shift+M

steps.title: Match Cards
steps.description: Each match shows the connected note, match score, explanation, and suggested actions (link, reply, follow).

steps.title: Describe What You Need
steps.description: Use 'Describe It' to express what you're looking for in natural language

action.value: Notes about project planning and task management

steps.title: Submit Description
steps.description: Press Enter or click the search icon to find matches

steps.title: Review Results
steps.description: Review AI-generated matches with explanations. Click any match to open the note or start a chat.
